title: Zephyrine and the Terminal
author: Elodie Ishikawa
blurb: Ivo Ashgrove, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
